To help you find the photos and videos you’re looking for, you can change how items in the library are sorted, filter the library to show only particular items, and hide certain items.

Sort the library

You can sort items in your photo library to appear by the date they were added or by the date they were taken.

  1. Go to the Photos app on your iPhone.

  2. Tap [Image: the Sort and Filter button], then choose one of the following options:

    • Sort by Recently Added: Photos and videos you added most recently appear at the bottom of the library.
    • Sort by Date Captured: Photos and videos are sorted by the date they were taken, instead of the date they were added to the library.

Filter the library

You can apply filters to your photo library to display only particular items—such as Videos, Favorites, or Not in an Album—and temporarily hide everything else.

  1. Go to the Photos app on your iPhone.

  2. Tap [Image: the Sort and Filter button], then tap Filter.

  3. Tap the filter you want to apply.

    Tip: You can apply multiple filters at the same time. For example, tap Photos and Edited to see only photos you’ve edited.

  4. To remove the filters and return to the full library, tap All Items.

Hide screenshots, items from your Mac, and items shared with you

By default, screenshots, photos and videos synced from your Mac, and photos and videos shared with you in the Messages app automatically appear in your photo library. You can hide these items to reduce clutter.

  1. Go to the Photos app on your iPhone.
  2. Tap [Image: the Sort and Filter button], then tap View Options.
  3. Tap Screenshots, From My Mac, or Shared with You to hide these items in your library. To stop hiding them, tap the option again.

See alsoFilter and sort photos and videos in albums on iPhone

Trim video length, adjust speed, and edit audio

In the Photos app, you can trim a video you recorded on your iPhone to change where it starts and stops. You can also adjust the playback speed, and change the portion of a video that appears in slow motion when you record in Slo-mo mode.

When you record a video with Spatial Audio, you can use Audio Mix to edit the sound in the Photos app (available on supported models).

Trim a video

  1. Go to the Photos app on your iPhone.
  2. Open a video, then tap [Image: the Edit button].
  3. Drag either end of the frame viewer below the video to adjust the start and stop times, then tap Done.
  4. Tap Save Video to save only the trimmed video, or Save Video as New Clip to save both versions of the video.

To undo edits after you save, open the video, tap [Image: the Edit button], then tap Revert.

Note: A video saved as a new clip can’t be reverted to the original.

Edit the video playback speed

You can slow down videos that were captured at a high frame rate for a dramatic effect.

  1. Go to the Photos app on your iPhone.

  2. Open a video, tap [Image: the Edit button], then tap Video.

  3. Tap [Image: the Playback Speed button], then tap a playback speed.

    Note: The playback options available depend on the format of the video you captured. The larger the format you capture, the more options are available.

Edit the slow-motion section of a video shot in Slo-mo mode

  1. Go to the Photos app on your iPhone.
  2. Open a video shot in Slo-mo mode, then tap [Image: the Edit button].
  3. Drag the black vertical bars beneath the frame viewer to set where the video is played in slow motion.

Edit sound with Audio Mix

When you record a video with iPhone 16 or later, you can choose between three recording options: Spatial Audio, Studio, and Mono. When you record with Spatial Audio, you can use Audio Mix to customize the sound in your video.

  1. Go to the Photos app on your iPhone.

  2. Open a video, then tap [Image: the Edit button].

  3. Tap Audio Mix, then choose one of the following:

    • Standard: Play the original audio you recorded.
    • In-Frame: Reduce sounds and voices from sources not visible in the video frame.
    • Studio: Reduce background sounds and reverb, to make it sound more like you’re recording in a professional studio.
    • Cinematic: Put all the voices onto a front-facing track and leave environmental noises in surround, like the audio in movies.

  4. Drag the slider below the mix options to increase or decrease the effect and background noise levels.

  5. Tap Done.

See alsoEdit photos and videos on iPhoneEdit Cinematic mode videos on iPhoneUndo and revert photo edits on iPhone

Undo and revert photo edits

While you edit a photo or video, you can undo and redo changes. After saving, if you don’t like how your changes look, you can revert back to the original.

When you use iCloud Photos, any edits you make to your photos and videos are saved across all your devices.

Undo and redo as you edit

As you edit a photo or video, tap [Image: the Undo button] and [Image: the Redo button] at the top of the screen to undo and redo multiple edit steps.

Tip: You can tap the photo or video to compare the edited version to the original.

Revert an edited photo or video

To undo edits after you save, you can revert to the original.

  1. Go to the Photos app on your iPhone.
  2. Open the edited photo or video, then tap [Image: the More button].
  3. Tap Revert to Original.

See alsoEdit photos and videos on iPhoneCrop, rotate, flip, or straighten photos and videos on iPhoneEdit Portrait mode photos on iPhone

Use iCloud Shared Photo Library

After you set up or join an iCloud Shared Photo Library, you can share photos and videos with friends and family in the Photos app. You and up to five other participants can add photos and videos to the library, and any edits, comments, or other adjustments made to them are seen by everyone in real time. Content in a shared library is also added to everyone’s memories, featured photos, and the Photos widget.

Photos and videos added to a shared library are separate from your personal library. You can easily switch between viewing the shared library, your personal library, or both in the Photos app.

Switch between viewing your iCloud Shared Photo Library and personal library

  1. Go to the Photos app on your iPhone.

  2. Make sure Library is selected in the bottom-left corner.

  3. Tap [Image: the Sort and Filter], then select the following:

    • View your Photos content and iCloud Shared Photo Library content: Tap Both Libraries.
    • View only your personal Photos content: Tap Personal Library.
    • View only iCloud Shared Photo Library content: Tap Shared Library.

When you view both your personal and shared library, content that’s part of the shared library has a badge in the top-right corner of the thumbnail.

Make edits and changes to content in an iCloud Shared Photo Library

When you make the following changes to photos and videos in an iCloud Shared Photo Library, all participants see the changes:

  • Edits; see Edit photos and videos.

  • Favorites, captions, keywords, or date and time adjustments; see See photo and video information.

  • Deleted content; see Delete or hide photos and videos.

    Note: You receive notifications if content you added to the shared library is deleted. To turn off notifications, tap your account in the top-right corner of the screen in Photos, tap Shared Library, then turn off Deletion Notifications. If content you added is deleted, you can move it from Recently Deleted back to your personal library within 30 days.

Move shared content from an iCloud Shared Photo Library to your personal library

Photos that are stored in your shared library have a badge in their top-right corner. You can move photos and videos that you contributed to the shared library back to your personal library.

  1. Go to the Photos app on your iPhone.
  2. Open a photo or video in your shared library.
  3. Tap [Image: the More button] at the top of the screen, then tap Move to Personal Library.

Add storage space to your iCloud Shared Photo Library

The content in an iCloud Shared Photo Library is available to all participants, but the iCloud storage used to store the content counts against the library organizer’s storage space.

If the shared library content exceeds the organizer’s available storage space, the organizer can upgrade to iCloud+ or add additional storage to their existing iCloud+ subscription. See Subscribe to iCloud+.

See alsoSet up or join an iCloud Shared Photo Library on iPhoneAdd content to an iCloud Shared Photo Library on iPhone

View photos and videos

Use the Photos app to view photos and videos on your iPhone.

View photos

  1. Go to the Photos app on your iPhone.

  2. Tap a photo to view it in full screen.

    Tip: Tap [Image: the Spatial Scene button], then move your iPhone in your hand to view the photo with a 3D effect (available on iPhone 12 or later).

  3. Swipe left or right on the photo to keep browsing, or swipe the thumbnails below the photo to quickly jump forward or back.

  4. Tap [Image: the Back button] to close the photo and return to the library or collection.

Tip: To focus on the photo you’re viewing, tap it to hide the controls onscreen. Tap it again to show the controls.

Play videos

  1. Go to the Photos app on your iPhone.

  2. Tap a video to play it.

    As the video plays, you can pause the video, or drag the white bar to go forward or back in the video.

  3. Tap [Image: the Back button] to close the video and return to the library or collection.

See alsoSearch for photos and videos on iPhoneSort and filter the photo library on iPhoneEdit photos and videos on iPhoneSee photo and video information on iPhone

View your memories

The Memories collection in the Photos app includes personalized collections of photos and videos that feature a significant person, pet, place, activity, or event from your photo library.

View your memories

  1. Go to the Photos app on your iPhone.

  2. Tap Collections.

  3. Swipe left under Memories to scroll through a selection of your memories, or tap Memories to view them all.

  4. Select a memory to view all the photos and videos included in that memory.

  5. As you view a memory, you can do any of the following:

    • Filter and sort the photos videos in the memory: Tap [Image: the Sort and Filter button].
    • View all the photos and videos in the memory: Tap Show All
    • Search for photos and videos in the memory: Tap [Image: the Search button].
    • Share the memory, delete the memory, or show the memory location on a map: Tap [Image: the More button].
    • Share specific photos and videos in the memory: Tap Select, tap the photos and videos you want to share, then tap [Image: the Share button].
    • Play the memory movie: Tap [Image: the Play button].

  6. Tap [Image: the Back button] to close the memory and return to Collections.

Add a memory to Favorites

Identify your favorite memories to make them easier to find.

  1. Go to the Photos app on your iPhone.
  2. Tap Collections.
  3. Swipe left under Memories to scroll through a selection of your memories, or tap Memories to view them all.
  4. Touch and hold a memory, then tap Add to Favorite Memories.

To view your favorite memories, go to the Collections tab, tap Memories, then tap Favorites.

See alsoPersonalize your memory movies in Photos on iPhoneShare or delete memories in Photos on iPhone

Apps: Podcasts

Change download settings

Podcasts you follow are automatically downloaded to your Apple device. Episodes you’ve played are automatically deleted from your device. You can change these settings, and adjust other download options.

Turn automatic downloads on or off

  1. Go to the Settings app  on your iPhone.
  2. Tap Apps, then tap Podcasts.
  3. Tap Automatically Download, then tap an option.

Tip: To automatically download episodes from a particular podcast, go to the Podcasts app , tap Library, then tap Shows. Touch and hold the show, then tap Settings. Tap Automatically Download to limit automatic downloads to a certain number of episodes or a timeframe. Tap Download Video to choose whether to download video.

Remove downloaded podcasts after you watch or listen to them

  1. Go to the Settings app  on your iPhone.

  2. Tap Apps, then tap Podcasts.

  3. Turn on Remove Played Downloads.

    To adjust this setting for a particular podcast you follow, tap Library, tap Shows, then touch and hold the show. Tap Settings, then turn on Remove Played Downloads.

Resume automatic downloads

If you haven’t watched or listened to a show you follow in a while, new episodes stop downloading automatically. You can resume automatic downloads at any time.

  1. Go to the Podcasts app on your iPhone.
  2. Tap Library, tap Shows, then tap a show.
  3. Tap [Image: the Resume Automatic Downloads button], then tap Turn On Automatic Downloads.

Turn off automatic syncing across Apple devices

  1. Go to the Settings app  on your iPhone.
  2. Tap Apps, then tap Podcasts.
  3. Turn off Sync Library.

See alsoDownload, save, remove, and share podcast episodes on iPhone

Download, save, remove, and share podcasts

In the Podcasts app, you can download, save, remove, and share podcast episodes.

Download an episode

  1. Go to the Podcasts app on your iPhone.

  2. Do any of the following:

    • While viewing show information: Swipe left on an episode, then tap [Image: the Download button].
    • While viewing episode information: Tap [Image: the Download button].

You can also tap [Image: the More button], then tap Download.

Save an episode

  1. Go to the Podcasts app on your iPhone.

  2. Do any of the following:

    • While viewing show information: Swipe left on an episode, then tap [Image: the Save button].

      You can also tap [Image: the More button] below an episode in the list, then tap Save Episode.

    • While viewing episode information: Tap [Image: the Save button].

      You can also tap [Image: the More button], then tap Save.

When you save an episode, it’s automatically downloaded so you can listen to it offline. To turn off this option, go to Settings  > Apps > Podcasts, then turn off Download When Saving.

By default, only audio is downloaded for video episodes. To download video as well, go to Settings  > Apps > Podcasts, then turn Download Video on.

Remove a saved episode

  1. Go to the Podcasts app on your iPhone.

  2. Do any of the following:

    • From the library: Tap Saved, then tap [Image: the Unsave button] near the episode name.
    • While viewing show or episode information: Tap [Image: the Unsave button] near the episode name.

You can also tap [Image: the More button] near the episode name, then tap Unsave.

Remove a downloaded episode

  1. Go to the Podcasts app on your iPhone.

  2. Do any of the following:

    • From the library: Tap Downloaded, then tap a show. Swipe left on an episode, then tap Remove Download.

      You can also tap [Image: the Download button] or [Image: the More button] near the episode name, then tap Remove Download.

    • While viewing show information: Tap [Image: the Down button] next to Episodes, then tap Downloaded. Tap [Image: the Download button] or [Image: the More button] near the episode name, then tap Remove Download.

    • While viewing episode information: Tap [Image: the Download button] or [Image: the More button], then tap Remove Download.

Remove all downloaded episodes from a show

  1. Go to the Podcasts app on your iPhone.
  2. Tap Library, then tap Shows.
  3. Touch and hold a show, then tap Remove Downloads.

Remove all downloaded episodes

  1. Go to the Podcasts app on your iPhone.
  2. Tap Library, then tap Downloaded.
  3. Tap [Image: the More button], then tap Remove All Downloads.

Share a podcast show or episode

  1. Go to the Podcasts app on your iPhone.

  2. Do any of the following:

    • While viewing show information: Tap [Image: the More button] near the top right, then tap Share.

    • While viewing episode information: Tap [Image: the Share button].

    • To specify the starting time for a shared episode: From the Now Playing screen, tap [Image: the More button], then tap Share. Tap From Start, choose From [time], then tap [Image: the Done button].

      The shared episode starts from the point where you’re watching or listening when you tap Share.

  3. Choose how to share the show or episode.

See alsoSubscribe to a show or channel in Podcasts on iPhone

Find podcasts

Use the Podcasts app to find shows about science, news, politics, comedy, and more. If you find a show you like, you can follow it to add it to your library. Then you can easily watch or listen offline, get notified about new episodes, access followed shows on your other Apple devices and on Apple Podcasts on the web, and more.

Note: Shows may offer paid subscriptions that give you access to exclusive episodes, new releases, episodes without ads, and more. You can subscribe to a show or channel and manage your subscriptions. If you already subscribe to Apple Music, Apple News+, or an eligible third-party app, you can play its subscriber content in Podcasts. See Listen to subscriber-only content.

Find podcasts

  1. Go to the Podcasts app on your iPhone.

  2. Do any of the following:

    • Search by category, title, person, or topic: Tap [Image: the Search button], then enter a word or phrase in the search field. Top hits appear as you type.

      Tap [Image: the Search button] on the onscreen keyboard to view all results for the word or phrase you typed. Tap a show, channel, or episode to go directly to it.

    • Discover new shows: Tap New to see new and trending shows, and the Apple editorial collections. Or tap Search and get a personalized list of categories to choose from, as well as editorial collections.

      Tip: To quickly see the top shows and episodes for a specific category, tap Top Charts, tap the All Categories pop-up menu in the top-right corner, then tap a category.

    • Add shows by URL: Tap Library, tap [Image: the More button], then tap Follow a Show by URL. Enter the URL, then tap Follow.

      Note: The URL must be for a valid podcast RSS feed.

Get personalized recommendations

You can get personalized podcast recommendations based on your watching and listening activity and your favorite channels and categories.

  1. Go to the Podcasts app on your iPhone.

  2. Tap Home.

  3. Do any of the following:

    • View recommended shows: Scroll left or right in the You Might Like row.

    • Refine your show recommendations: Tap a show in the You Might Like row, tap [Image: the More button], then tap Suggest Less.

    • View suggested episodes based on your watching and listening: Scroll down to the More to Discover row, then scroll left or right.

    • Opt out of personalized recommendations: Tap [Image: the My Account button] or your profile picture, tap your name, then turn off Personalized Recommendations.

      Note: Your Personalized Recommendations setting also applies to the App Store, Apple Books, iTunes Store, Apple TV, and subscriptions from Apple.

Other recommendations are available based on categories you watch and listen to and any subscriptions you already purchased.

View shared podcasts

When a friend shares a show or episode with you in Messages, you can easily find it in Podcasts.

  1. Go to the Podcasts app on your iPhone.

  2. Tap Home, then scroll down to the Shared with You section.

    If you don’t see Shared with You, check to make sure your friend is in your contacts, and that Podcasts is turned on in Settings  > Apps > Messages > Shared with You.

See also Find all the content someone shared with you.

Browse episodes within a specific podcast

  1. Go to the Podcasts app on your iPhone.
  2. Search or browse for a show.
  3. Tap the show, then scroll down to see recent episodes, (or tap See All, if available).

Filter episodes

If you follow a show, or have saved or downloaded at least one of its episodes, you can choose filter options for it.

  1. Go to the Podcasts app on your iPhone.
  2. Search or browse for a show.
  3. Tap the show, then tap Episodes (or the current filter) above the list of episodes.
  4. Choose an option, like Unplayed or Season 1.

See alsoDownload, save, remove, and share podcast episodes on iPhoneWatch and listen to podcasts on iPhone

Follow your favorite podcasts

When you find a show you like in the Podcasts app, follow it to add it to your library so you can get notified about new episodes, change the playback order, and more.

Follow a podcast

When you follow a podcast, it’s added to your library. You can access podcasts you follow on your other Apple devices, or on the Apple Podcasts app.

  1. Go to the Podcasts app on your iPhone.

  2. Search or browse for a show.

  3. Do any of the following:

    • From search results: Tap [Image: the Follow button].

    • While viewing show information: Tap [Image: the Follow button].

      You can also tap [Image: the More button], then tap Follow.

    • While viewing episode information, or from Now Playing: Tap [Image: the More button], then tap Follow Show.

Unfollow a podcast

  1. Go to the Podcasts app on your iPhone.

  2. Tap Library, then tap Shows.

  3. Tap a show you follow, tap [Image: the Unfollow button], then tap Unfollow Show.

    You can also tap [Image: the More button], then tap Unfollow.

Get notifications for new episodes

Get notified when new episodes are available for podcasts you follow.

  1. Go to the Podcasts app on your iPhone.
  2. Tap Home.
  3. Tap [Image: the My Account button] or your profile picture.
  4. Tap Notifications, then turn Notifications on or off for one or more shows.

Customize playback speed and Enhance Dialogue settings for a show you follow

  1. Go to the Podcasts app on your iPhone.
  2. Tap Library, tap Shows, then select a show. (You can also search or browse for a show you follow.)
  3. Tap [Image: the More button], tap Settings, then scroll down to Speed & Audio Adjustments.
  4. Choose Custom for This Show, then select a playback speed and turn Enhance Dialogue on or off.

See alsoSubscribe to a show or channel in Podcasts on iPhoneFind podcasts on iPhoneOrganize your podcast library on iPhone

Get started with Podcasts on iPhone

The Podcasts app offers millions of shows on a variety of topics such as news, true crime, comedy, and more. You can watch or listen online, or download episodes so you can play them even when you’re not connected to the internet.

Find podcasts

You can use the Search feature to find categories, channels, shows, or episodes that match your interests. Tap [Image: the Search button] or Search to browse shows by category. Enter a word or phrase such as a show name, person, or category to search for something specific.

Watch and listen to podcasts

Tap [Image: the Play button] to start playing a show or episode. For audio episodes, tap the MiniPlayer at the bottom of the screen to open the Now Playing screen, where you can access playback controls, view your queue or transcript, and select output devices for audio and video. Video episodes open directly in the Now Playing screen with full playback controls.

Follow a show

When you find a show you like, tap [Image: the Follow button] to add it to your library. You can choose whether to automatically download new episodes of shows you follow and get notifications when new episodes are available.

Want to learn more?

  • Find podcasts on iPhone
  • Watch and listen to podcasts on iPhone
  • Follow your favorite podcasts on iPhone

  • View podcast transcripts on iPhone

Listen to subscriber-only content

In the Podcasts app, you can listen to content from Apple Music, Apple News+, and eligible third-party subscription apps.

Note: Not all apps offer content that’s available in Podcasts.

Connect app subscriptions to Podcasts

Your eligible app subscriptions are automatically connected to Podcasts if you subscribed through the App Store and the app offers content in Podcasts.

If you subscribed using another method, do the following:

  1. Go to the Podcasts app on your iPhone.
  2. Browse or search for a channel with an eligible subscription.
  3. On the Channel page, tap the Already a Subscriber link, then follow the instructions to connect your app subscription.

After an app subscription is connected, you can find the channel in your library. You can use Podcasts to play all subscriber-only shows and episodes.

See alsoSubscribe to a show or channel in Podcasts on iPhone

Organize your podcast library

In the Podcasts app, you can organize the podcasts you follow, catch up on the latest episodes, and create your own stations.

View your podcast library

  1. Go to the Podcasts app on your iPhone.

  2. Tap Library at the bottom of the screen to see the following options:

    • Shows: Tap Followed to view shows you follow. If you downloaded or saved episodes from podcasts you don’t follow, tap All to see them. You can tap any show to see its information or the episodes you downloaded or saved.
    • Channels: See channels you subscribe to, channels you added to your favorites, and channels that have shows you follow. You can tap a channel to browse all of its shows.
    • Categories: See categories you added to your favorites, along with categories for any shows you follow.
    • Saved: See episodes you saved.
    • Downloaded: See episodes you downloaded. You can watch or listen to these episodes without an internet connection.
    • Latest Episodes: See the most recent episodes from each show you follow. To change how long episodes stay in this playlist, tap [Image: the More button].
    • Stations: If you created stations, each one is listed.

Change the episode playback order

  1. Go to the Podcasts app on your iPhone.

  2. Tap Library, then tap Shows.

  3. Touch and hold a show, then tap Settings.

  4. Choose an option under Episode Order.

    When you play an episode from the show page, the remaining episodes play based on the order you choose.

Set download limits for each podcast

  1. Go to the Podcasts app on your iPhone.
  2. Tap Library, then tap Shows.
  3. Touch and hold a show, then tap Settings.
  4. Tap Automatically Download, then choose an option.
  5. Tap Download Video, then choose On to download video for offline playback, or Off to download audio only.

Mark an episode as played

Do any of the following:

  • While viewing show information: Swipe right on an episode, then tap Played.
  • While viewing episode information: Tap [Image: the More button], then tap Mark as Played.

Hide episodes you already played

You can change a show’s settings to hide episodes you’ve already played.

  1. Go to the Podcasts app on your iPhone.
  2. Tap Library, tap Shows, then touch and hold a show.
  3. Tap Settings, then turn on Hide Played Episodes.

To automatically hide played episodes for all shows you follow, go to Settings  > Apps > Podcasts, then turn on Hide Played Episodes.

Create your own station

Use stations (similar to a music playlist) to group shows you follow based on themes like news, comedy, or morning commute. Episodes from the podcasts you choose are automatically added to your station regularly.

  1. Go to the Podcasts app on your iPhone.
  2. Tap Library, then tap [Image: the More button] near the top right.
  3. Tap New Station, add a title, then tap Save.
  4. Tap Choose Podcasts, then tap the shows you want to add to the station (or turn on Include All Podcasts).
  5. Tap [Image: the Back button], then tap [Image: the Close button].

Tip: You can adjust the number of episodes from each podcast that are added to your station. Tap the station, tap [Image: the More button], then tap Station Settings. To use the same settings for all podcasts in a station, tap Episodes, then choose an option. To adjust the settings for a single show, tap the show in the Podcasts list, then choose an option.

See alsoDownload, save, remove, and share podcast episodes on iPhone

Rate or review podcasts

You can rate and review a show, read reviews from other listeners, and delete a review you wrote if you later change your mind.

Rate or review a show

  1. Go to the Podcasts app on your iPhone.

  2. Search or browse for a show.

  3. Tap the show you want to rate or review, then scroll down to Ratings & Reviews.

  4. Do any of the following:

    • Rate a show: Tap a star to rate the show from 1 to 5.
    • Review a show: Tap Write a Review. Tap a star to rate the show, enter your review, then tap [Image: the Submit button].
    • Edit a review: Tap Write a Review, make any changes, then tap [Image: the Submit button].

Delete a rating or review

  1. Go to the Podcasts app on your iPhone.
  2. Tap Home at the bottom of the screen, then tap [Image: the My Account button] or your profile picture.
  3. Tap your name (you may need to sign in), then tap Ratings and Reviews.
  4. Tap Edit, then tap [Image: the Remove button].
  5. Tap Done.

See alsoFollow your favorite podcasts on iPhoneSubscribe to a show or channel in Podcasts on iPhone

Select your favorite Podcasts categories and channels

You can select your favorite categories and channels in the Podcasts app to get better show recommendations and access shows from your subscriptions.

Select your favorite categories

You can add categories to your favorites for better show recommendations and easier access to category pages. Favorite categories rank higher in search results and appear at the top of the Manage Categories screen with a [Image: Favorite icon].

  1. Go to the Podcasts app on your iPhone.

  2. Tap Library, tap Categories, then tap Manage.

  3. Do any of the following:

    • Add a category to your favorites: Select one or more categories.
    • Remove a category from your favorites: Tap [Image: the Remove Favorite button].

Select your favorite channels

You can add channels to your favorites to make them easier to find in your library, and remove them if you change your mind. Your favorite channels appear at the top of the Channels section in the Library with a [Image: Favorite icon].

Note: Channels doesn’t appear in the Library tab if you haven’t subscribed to a channel, followed a show offered by a channel, or added a channel as a favorite.

  1. Go to the Podcasts app on your iPhone.

  2. Tap Library, then tap Channels.

    You can also search or browse for a channel.

  3. Do any of the following:

    • Add a channel to your favorites: Tap the channel, then tap [Image: the Favorite button].
    • Remove a channel from your favorites: Tap the channel, then tap [Image: the Remove Favorite button].

See alsoFollow your favorite podcasts on iPhoneSubscribe to a show or channel in Podcasts on iPhone

Subscribe to podcasts

In the Podcasts app, subscribe to, change, cancel, and share your podcast subscriptions. Paid subscriptions allow you to support the shows you love, and they often include premium extras, early access to new episodes, or ad-free listening.

Note: Not all subscriptions and channels are available in all countries, regions, or languages. See the Apple Support article Availability of Apple Media Services.

Subscribe to a show or channel

  1. Go to the Podcasts app on your iPhone.
  2. Select the show or channel you want to subscribe to.
  3. Tap the subscription button (if available).

When you subscribe to a show, you automatically follow it. You can access shows you subscribe to or follow on your other Apple devices or on the Apple Podcasts app. See Follow your favorite podcasts. When you subscribe to a channel or follow one of its shows, the channel appears in the Channels section of your library.

Change or cancel your subscriptions

  1. Go to the Podcasts app on your iPhone.
  2. Tap Home.
  3. Tap [Image: the My Account button] or your profile picture, then tap Manage Subscriptions.
  4. Tap a subscription to change or cancel it.

Share Apple Podcasts subscriptions

When you subscribe to podcast channels, you can use Family Sharing to share your subscriptions with up to five other family members. Your family group members will automatically have access to the channels you subscribe to.

If you join a family group and a family group member subscribes to a show you already subscribe to, your subscription isn’t renewed on your next billing date; instead, you use the group’s subscription. If you join a family group that doesn’t subscribe, the group uses your subscription.

Note: To stop sharing a show subscription with a family group, you can cancel the subscription or leave a Family Sharing group.

See alsoApple Support article: Get and manage your Apple Podcasts SubscriptionsListen to subscriber-only content in Podcasts on iPhone

Use the Podcasts widget

You can add the Podcasts widget to your Home Screen to view and play episodes without opening the Podcasts app . You can add episodes from the Up Next queue, saved episodes, or episodes from a show you follow.

Add a Podcasts widget to the Home Screen

  1. Touch and hold the Home Screen until the apps begin to jiggle.
  2. Tap Edit at the top left, then tap Add Widget to open the widget gallery.
  3. Scroll down, then tap Podcasts.
  4. Swipe left and right to view the different widget sizes and layouts. When you see the option you like, tap Add Widget.

To move the widget on your Home Screen, touch and hold the Home Screen until the apps begin to jiggle. Drag the widget to a new location, then tap Done.

To remove the widget from your Home Screen, touch and hold the Home Screen until the apps begin to jiggle, tap [Image: the Remove button] at the top left of the widget, then tap Remove.

See alsoWatch and listen to podcasts on iPhone

View podcast transcripts

In the Podcasts app, you can view and search episode transcripts.

Note: Transcript availability may vary by language, and by country or region. See the Apple Support article Follow and play shows in Apple Podcasts on iPhone and iPad.

View transcripts

  1. Go to the Podcasts app on your iPhone.

  2. Do any of the following:

    • While viewing episode information: Scroll down to the Transcripts section. You can also tap [Image: the More button], then tap View Transcript.
    • From the Now Playing screen: Tap [Image: the View Transcript button]. (You may first need to tap the MiniPlayer to open the Now Playing screen.)

Transcripts aren’t available when watching in full-screen video mode. Instead, you can tap [Image: the Captions button] to view subtitles (if available).

You can interact with transcripts in multiple ways. In the static transcript view, you can select text and choose whether to play, copy, or share from that point. In the scrolling transcript on the Now Playing screen, you can tap any paragraph to jump to that point in the episode, or touch and hold a paragraph to share from that point.

To hide the transcript on the Now Playing screen, swipe down, then tap [Image: the Hide Transcript button] below the volume slider.

Search transcripts

  1. Go to the Podcasts app on your iPhone.

  2. While viewing a transcript, do one of the following:

    • From the Now Playing screen: Swipe up on the transcript, then tap Search.
    • From episode details or the Up Next section: Tap [Image: the Search Transcript button].

  3. Optionally, tap [Image: the Search Options button] in the search field to specify whether the whole word or the capitalization needs to match in the search results.

You can read along with an episode as you play it. To jump to a specific time in the episode, tap a paragraph, then tap Play (if it appears).

See alsoWatch and listen to podcasts on iPhone

Watch and listen to podcasts

In the Podcasts app, you can play video and audio podcasts. You can change the playback speed, see what’s playing next, watch or listen to an episode when you’re offline, set a sleep timer, and use other playback controls. You can also navigate episodes by chapter, discover content mentioned in an episode, and access links shared by podcast creators.

Play a podcast

  1. Go to the Podcasts app on your iPhone.

  2. Do one of the following:

    • Find a podcast: Search or browse for an episode.
    • Choose a recently played podcast: Tap Home, then scroll to the Recently Played section.

  3. Tap [Image: the Play button] below an episode title.

    The episode appears in the MiniPlayer, where you can pause it, resume playing, or skip ahead.

Open the Now Playing screen

  1. Go to the Podcasts app on your iPhone.

  2. Play a podcast.

  3. Tap the MiniPlayer at the bottom of the screen to open the Now Playing screen.

  4. In the Now Playing screen, do any of the following:

    • Jump to a specific time: Drag the slider below the episode information.
    • Switch between video and audio modes: While playing a video podcast, tap Turn Video Off or Turn Video On.
    • Adjust the volume: Touch and hold the volume bar, then slide your finger left or right.
    • Change the playback speed: Tap [Image: the Playback Speed button] (or the current playback speed), then select a speed, or scroll left or right to adjust the speed. You can also touch and hold [Image: The Playback Speed button] (or the current playback speed), then slide your finger up or down to choose a speed.
    • Hear voices more clearly: Tap [Image: the Playback Speed button] (or the current playback speed), then tap Enhance Dialogue.
    • Skip back or forward: Tap [Image: the Skip Back button] to jump back 15 seconds or [Image: the Skip Forward button] to jump ahead 30 seconds.
    • Set a sleep timer: Tap [Image: the Sleep Timer button], then choose an option.
    • Jump to a chapter: When chapters are available, tap [Image: the Playing Next button], tap [Image: the Down arrow] next to the name of the current chapter, then select the chapter you want to play.
    • Explore other media mentioned in an episode: When a podcast mentions content that’s available in apps such as Music, Apple TV, Books, Podcasts, or News, tap the mentioned item in the player or transcript to view details or access the content.
    • Show or hide the episode transcript: If [Image: the View Transcript button] or [Image: the Hide Transcript button] appears, tap the button. Mentioned podcasts appear as tappable links in the transcript.
    • Play the video or audio on another device: Tap [Image: the AirPlay button].
    • Show or hide the queue: Tap [Image: the Playing Next button].
    • Access more options: Tap [Image: the More button].

Use controls in full-screen video mode

When watching a video podcast, you can expand it to fill the entire screen for an immersive viewing experience.

  1. Go to the Podcasts app on your iPhone.

  2. Play a video podcast.

  3. Tap the video thumbnail to expand the video to full screen.

  4. Do any of the following:

    • Change the playback speed: Touch and hold [Image: the Playback Speed button], then slide your finger up or down to choose a speed.
    • Choose options for subtitles: If you see [Image: the Captions button], tap it, then choose an option.
    • Stream sound to another device: Tap [Image: the AirPlay button].
    • Highlight or copy text that appears in the video: Tap [Image: the More button], then tap Show Text. Optionally, tap Copy All to copy the text to the Clipboard.
    • Switch to picture-in-picture view: Tap [Image: the Picture-in-Picture Start button].
    • Exit full-screen video mode: Tap [Image: the Close button].

Access episode links

  1. Go to the Podcasts app on your iPhone.
  2. Search or browse for an episode.
  3. On the episode page, tap a highlighted link to open the content.

Choose what to play next

You can add episodes to your queue, then watch or listen to them later.

  1. Go to the Podcasts app on your iPhone.

  2. Find a podcast.

  3. Tap [Image: the More button] for an episode, then choose Play Next or Add to Queue.

  4. Tap [Image: the Playing Next button] in the Now Playing screen.

    If you don’t see [Image: the Playing Next button], tap the MiniPlayer near the bottom of the screen to open the Now Playing screen.

  5. In the Queue section, do any of the following:

    • Play an episode: Tap the episode. The next episode in the queue plays immediately after the previous episode finishes.
    • Reorder episodes: Drag [Image: the Reorder button] to move an episode up or down in the list.
    • Remove an episode from the queue: Swipe left on the episode, then tap Remove.
    • Remove all episodes from the queue: Tap Clear.

If you watch or listen to multiple episodes of a show in a row, additional episodes appear in the Continue Playing section of the Now Playing screen. These episodes play after the ones you added to the Queue section, so you can easily pick up where you left off in a show. You can also tap an episode in Continue Playing to start watching or listening right away.

See alsoOrganize your podcast library on iPhoneListen to subscriber-only content in Podcasts on iPhone

Apps: Preview

Add, delete, rotate, move, or crop PDF pages

You can add, delete, rotate, reorder, or crop pages in a PDF.

Add or delete pages

  1. Go to the Preview app on your iPhone.

  2. Open a PDF.

  3. Tap the page count to show thumbnails. (If the page count doesn’t appear, pinch two fingers together or apart on the page.)

  4. Touch and hold a thumbnail, then do any of the following:

    • Insert a blank page: Tap Insert Blank Page.
    • Insert a PDF or image: Tap Insert from File.
    • Insert a scanned document: Tap Scan Pages, scan the document, then tap [Image: the Done button]. See Scan text and documents.
    • Delete the selected page: Tap Delete Page.

Rotate a page

  1. Go to the Preview app on your iPhone.
  2. Open a PDF.
  3. Tap [Image: the More button], then tap Rotate Left or Rotate Right.

Move a page

  1. Go to the Preview app on your iPhone.
  2. Open a PDF.
  3. Touch and hold a thumbnail until menu options appear, then drag the page thumbnail above or below another one. (If you don’t see thumbnails, tap the screen to show the page count, then tap the page count.)

Crop a page

  1. Go to the Preview app on your iPhone.
  2. Open a PDF.
  3. Scroll to the page you want to crop, then tap [Image: the Crop button].
  4. Drag the blue handles to select an area, tap within the selected area, then tap Crop.

To undo a change, tap [Image: the More button], then tap Undo.

See alsoOpen and view PDFs and images in Preview on iPhoneAnnotate a PDF or image in Preview on iPhone

Annotate a PDF or image

You can copy, highlight, underline, or strike through text in a PDF file. You can also annotate a PDF or image with stickers, signatures, shapes, or text.

Select and copy text

  1. Go to the Preview app on your iPhone.

  2. Open a PDF.

  3. To select text, touch and hold the first word, then move the grab points.

  4. To copy the selection, tap Copy.

    You can then paste the text into another document or app. See Select, cut, copy, and paste text.

Highlight, underline, or strike through text

  1. Go to the Preview app on your iPhone.
  2. Open a PDF.
  3. Select and copy text, then tap Highlight.
  4. Choose a highlight color, or tap the underline or strike through button.

Add an annotation

  1. Go to the Preview app on your iPhone.
  2. Open a PDF.
  3. Tap [Image: the Markup button] at the top of the screen, tap [Image: the Add button] at the bottom of the screen, then choose an option, such as a sticker, signature, shape, or text. For images, you can also add an image description or a loupe.

To undo a change, tap [Image: the More button], then tap Undo.

See alsoWrite and draw in documents with Markup on iPhone

Create an image

When you create an image in the Preview app, you can start with a blank image or with pasted content that was copied to the Clipboard.

Create an empty image

  1. Go to the Preview app on your iPhone.
  2. Tap New Document, then choose New Empty Image.

Use an image from the Clipboard

  1. Do any of the following to copy an image to the Clipboard:

    • From the Photos app: Select an image, tap [Image: the Share button], then tap Copy Photo.
    • From the Files app: Touch and hold an image file, then tap Copy.
    • From the Preview app: Touch and hold an image file, then tap Copy. You can also open an image file, tap [Image: the Share button], then tap Copy.

  2. Go to the Preview app on your iPhone.

  3. Tap New Document, then choose New from Clipboard.

You can annotate an empty image or an image from the Clipboard. Tap [Image: the Markup button], choose a drawing tool, then draw with your finger. You can also tap [Image: the Add button], then choose an option such as a shape, sticker, or text.

See alsoDuplicate and copy photos and videos on iPhoneSave, rename, or move PDFs and images in Preview on iPhoneExport or compress PDFs and images in Preview on iPhone

Edit an image

You can crop, rotate, or flip an image in Preview. You can also remove the background or adjust the image size.

Crop an image

  1. Go to the Preview app on your iPhone.
  2. Open an image.
  3. Tap [Image: the Crop button].
  4. Drag the blue handles to select an area, tap within the selected area, then tap Crop.

Rotate or flip an image

  1. Go to the Preview app on your iPhone.

  2. Open an image.

  3. Do any of the following:

    • Rotate the image: Tap [Image: the More button], then choose Rotate Left or Rotate Right.
    • Flip the image: Tap [Image: the More button], then choose Flip Horizontally or Flip Vertically.

Remove the background from an image

  1. Go to the Preview app on your iPhone.
  2. Open an image.
  3. Tap [Image: the More button], then tap Remove Background.

Adjust the size of an image

  1. Go to the Preview app on your iPhone.
  2. Open an image.
  3. Tap [Image: the More button], then tap Adjust Size. Choose options, then tap Done.

To undo a change, tap [Image: the More button], then tap Undo.

See alsoExport or compress PDFs and images in Preview on iPhoneAdd, delete, rotate, move, or crop PDF pages in Preview on iPhone

Export or compress PDFs and images

You can export a PDF or image as a HEIC, JPEG, JPEG-2000, PDF, PNG, or TIFF file. You can also compress the file.

  1. Go to the Preview app on your iPhone.

  2. Open a PDF or image.

  3. Tap [Image: the Actions Menu button] next to the filename, then tap Export.

  4. Select a file format.

    Available formats are HEIC, JPEG, PDF, PNG, and TIFF.

  5. Optionally, use the slider to adjust the file size.

See alsoSave, rename, or move PDFs and images in Preview on iPhoneAdd, delete, rotate, move, or crop PDF pages in Preview on iPhone

Fill out and sign PDF forms

You can fill out and sign PDF forms in the Preview app.

  1. Go to the Preview app on your iPhone.
  2. Open a PDF form.
  3. Tap [Image: the Form Filling button].
  4. Tap a field, then enter information (or tap the AutoFill suggestion above the onscreen keyboard to add that information).
  5. To add a signature or a text form box, tap [Image: the Add button].

See alsoLock PDFs in Preview on iPhoneAnnotate a PDF or image in Preview on iPhoneFill out forms, sign documents, and create signatures iPhone

Get started with Preview on iPhone

Learn how to use the Preview app to fill out and sign PDF forms, scan documents, and make changes to PDF documents and images.

Fill out PDF forms

To fill out a PDF form in Preview, tap [Image: the Form Filling button] and select a field. Enter text, or tap a suggestion that appears above the onscreen keyboard. If the field is a signature field, you can use your finger to add a signature.

Scan and save to create a PDF file

You can scan text or a document to create a PDF. Tap Scan Documents in the middle of the screen, position each page in the camera to capture it, then tap [Image: the Done button].

Protect a PDF document with a password

You can lock a PDF with a password. Open a PDF, tap [Image: the Actions Menu button] next to the filename, then tap Lock. Turn on Require Password, then enter a password in the Password and Verify fields.

Remove the background from an image

You can remove image backgrounds to focus on what’s important. Tap [Image: the More button] at the top of the screen, then choose Remove Background.

Highlight, underline, or strike through text

You can highlight, underline, or strike through text in a PDF. Open a PDF, then select text. Tap Highlight, then tap a highlight color, the underline button, or the strike through button.

Want to learn more?

  • Fill out and sign PDF forms in Preview on iPhone
  • Lock PDFs in Preview on iPhone
  • Edit an image in Preview on iPhone
  • Annotate a PDF or image in Preview on iPhone
  • Open and view PDFs and images in Preview on iPhone

Interact with text in an image

You can use Live Text in the Preview app to copy or translate text within an image, make a call, open a website, or start an email.

  1. Go to the Preview app on your iPhone.

  2. Open an image that shows text, then select the text. See Select, cut, copy, and paste text.

  3. Do any of the following:

    • Copy text: Tap Copy. You can then paste the text into another document or app.

    • Look up the meaning of text: Tap Look Up.

    • Translate text: Tap Translate, then choose a language.

      Note: Translation isn’t available in all languages and may not be available in some countries or regions.

    • Search the web for the text: Tap Image: the Forward button, then tap Search Web.

    • Call or text a phone number: Tap Call or Message. (You may need to tap Image: the Forward button to see all options.)

    • Save a phone number or email address: Tap Image: the Forward button, then tap Add to Contacts.

    • Send an email or message to an email address: Tap Email or Message. (You may need to tap Image: the Forward button to see all options.)

    • Go to a website: Tap Open Link. (You may need to tap Image: the Forward button to see the option.)

See alsoOpen and view PDFs and images in Preview on iPhoneEdit an image in Preview on iPhone

Lock PDFs

You can lock a PDF document with a password to prevent others from editing or deleting your work.

  1. Go to the Preview app on your iPhone.

  2. Open a PDF.

    Important: To keep a copy that’s not password-protected, tap [Image: the Actions Menu button], then tap Duplicate.

  3. Tap [Image: the Actions Menu button] next to the filename, then tap Lock.

  4. Turn on Require Password, then enter the same password in the Password and Verify fields.

  5. Tap Done.

See alsoAdd, delete, rotate, move, or crop PDF pages in Preview on iPhoneExport or compress PDFs and images in Preview on iPhone

Open and view PDFs and images

You can use the Preview app to open and view PDF documents and images.

Open a PDF or image

You can browse and open PDFs and images directly in Preview, without opening the Files app first.

  1. Go to the Preview app on your iPhone.

  2. Do any of the following to find a file:

    • View files you opened recently: Tap Recents.
    • View shared files: Tap Shared.
    • Browse available files: Tap Browse.
    • Choose a location to browse: Tap Browse, tap [Image: the Back button], then tap an option under Locations.
    • Browse by tag: Tap Browse, tap [Image: the Back button], then tap an option under Tags.

  3. Optionally, tap [Image: the More button], then select how items appear (icons or list) or how items are sorted.

  4. Tap a file to open it.

Tip: If someone emails you a PDF form to fill out, you can tap the attached file in the Mail app to open and complete the form in Preview. You can then reply to the sender and attach the completed form. See Reply to an email with a PDF attachment.

View a PDF or image

  1. Go to the Preview app on your iPhone.

  2. Open the PDF or image you want to view.

  3. Do any of the following:

    • Zoom in or out: Pinch two fingers open or closed on a page or image.
    • Show thumbnails for a PDF: Tap the page count. (If the page count doesn’t appear, tap the screen.)
    • Hide thumbnails for a PDF: Pinch two fingers open on a page until the thumbnails disappear.
    • Scroll pages in a PDF: Swipe up or down.
    • Go to a specific page in a PDF: Tap [Image: the More button], then tap Go to Page. Enter a page number, then tap Go.

Find text in a PDF

  1. Go to the Preview app on your iPhone.

  2. Open a PDF you want to search.

  3. Tap [Image: the Search button].

  4. Optionally, tap [Image: the Search Options button] in the search field and do any of the following:

    • Exclude matches where the search text is part of another word: Select Whole Word.
    • Only include results that match the capitalization of the search text: Select Match Case.

  5. Enter a word or phrase in the search field.

    If you enter a phrase, Preview searches for that exact phrase.

  6. Tap [Image: the Next Result button] or [Image: the Previous Result button] to go to the next or previous search result.

  7. Tap [Image: the Done button] to close the search results.

View information about a PDF or image

You can get information about PDF documents and images, such as creation date, filename, and more. When location information is available for a photo, you can also view the latitude and longitude where the photo was taken.

  1. Go to the Preview app on your iPhone.
  2. Open a PDF or image.
  3. Tap [Image: the Info button].

See alsoAnnotate a PDF or image in Preview on iPhoneFill out and sign PDF forms in Preview on iPhone

Print PDFs or images

  1. Go to the Preview app on your iPhone.
  2. Open a PDF or image.
  3. Tap [Image: the Actions Menu button] next to the filename, then tap Print.
  4. Select a printer, then tap [Image: the Print button].

See alsoOpen and view PDFs and images in Preview on iPhoneScan text and documents in Preview on iPhoneLock PDFs in Preview on iPhoneExport or compress PDFs and images in Preview on iPhone

Reply to an email with a PDF attachment

  1. Go to the Mail app on your iPhone.

  2. Open an email with a PDF attached, then tap the attachment to view it.

  3. Tap Preview in the toolbar to open it in the Preview app.

  4. Fill out or annotate the PDF.

  5. Go back to the Mail app, then open the original email.

  6. Tap [Image: the Reply button], tap [Image: the Attachment button], then tap Attach File.

    A reply to the sender appears in your inbox in the Mail app, with the updated PDF attached.

  7. Locate the updated PDF, then tap to select it.

  8. Optionally, add text to the reply.

  9. Tap [Image: the Send button].

See alsoAdd, delete, rotate, move, or crop PDF pages in Preview on iPhoneSave, rename, or move PDFs and images in Preview on iPhone

Save, rename, or move PDFs and images

  1. Go to the Preview app on your iPhone.

  2. Open a PDF or image.

  3. Do any of the following:

    • Save the file and return to the main menu: Tap [Image: the Back button].
    • Rename the file: Tap [Image: the Actions Menu button] next to the filename, then tap Rename. Enter a new filename, then tap Done on the onscreen keyboard.
    • Copy the PDF or image to the Clipboard: Tap [Image: the Share button], then tap Copy.
    • Create a duplicate: Tap [Image: the Actions Menu button] next to the filename, then tap Duplicate.
    • Export PDF or image in a different format: See Export or compress PDFs and images.
    • Move the file: Tap [Image: the Actions Menu button] next to the filename, then tap Move. Tap [Image: the Actions Menu button] next to Preview, then select a new location.

See alsoOpen and view PDFs and images in Preview on iPhoneLock PDFs in Preview on iPhonePrint PDFs or images in Preview on iPhone

Scan text and documents

You can scan text or a document to create a PDF.

  1. Go to the Preview app on your iPhone.

  2. Tap Scan Documents.

  3. Position the iPhone camera so the text or document appears on the screen.

    iPhone automatically captures the page. To capture the scan yourself instead of automatically, tap Auto (the label changes to Manual), then tap the Shutter button.

  4. Repeat the step above to scan additional pages.

  5. Tap the thumbnails at the bottom of the screen to crop, rotate, or adjust the coloring of the scan.

  6. Tap [Image: the Done button] when you’re finished scanning.

See alsoAdd, delete, rotate, move, or crop PDF pages in Preview on iPhoneSave, rename, or move PDFs and images in Preview on iPhone

Share PDFs or images

  1. Go to the Preview app on your iPhone.

  2. Open a PDF or image.

  3. Tap [Image: the Share button], then choose whether to collaborate on the file, send a copy of it, or copy it to the Clipboard. When you copy a file to the Clipboard, you can paste it into another app.

  4. If you choose Collaborate, tap Image: the Forward button next to “Only invited people can edit,” then do one of the following:

    • Allow only invitees to view and edit the contents: Tap “Only invited people,” then tap “Can make changes.”

      Turn off “Allow others to invite” if you don’t want people you share the file with to invite others to view and edit it.

    • Allow only invitees to view the contents: Tap “Only invited people,” then tap “View only.”

    • Allow anyone with the link to view and edit the contents: Tap “Anyone with the link,” then tap “Can make changes.”

    • Allow anyone with the link to view the contents: Tap “Anyone with the link,” then tap “View only.”

  5. Tap [Image: the Done button].

  6. Choose a sharing method, such as Mail or Messages.

See alsoReply to an email with a PDF attachment in Preview on iPhoneLock PDFs in Preview on iPhoneExport or compress PDFs and images in Preview on iPhone

Apps: Reminders

Add details

You can add details to your reminders such as notes, links, due dates, and photos.

Note: All Reminders features described in this guide are available when you use updated reminders in iCloud. Some features aren’t available when using other accounts.

Add a note, URL, and other details to a reminder

  1. Go to the Reminders app on your iPhone.
  2. Tap an item.
  3. Tap Add Note, then add more information.
  4. Tap [Image: the Edit Details button] to edit the item details. For example, you can set a date and time, set a location-based reminder, flag an important item, or attach a photo.

Set when and where to be reminded

You can be reminded on a certain date, at a specific time or location, or when you’re texting someone in Messages.

  1. Go to the Reminders app on your iPhone.

  2. Tap an item, then do any of the following:

    • Schedule a date and time: Tap [Image: the Date and Time button], then choose an option.

      Tip: Reminders with a due date appear as an all-day event in Calendar. See Use Reminders in Calendar.

    • Mark a reminder as urgent: Tap [Image: the Edit Details button], then turn on Urgent to get an alarm when the reminder is due. If Date and Time aren’t already set, they default to the next hour. You can edit Date and Time to change when the alarm activates.

    • Set a recurring reminder: Tap [Image: the Edit Details button], turn on Date or Time, tap Repeat, then choose the frequency.

    • Get an early reminder before the scheduled date and time: Tap [Image: the Edit Details button], tap Early Reminder, then choose when you want to be reminded. For example, “5 minutes before,” “2 days before,” or another choice.

    • Add a location: Tap [Image: the Location button], then choose where you want to be reminded—for example, when you arrive home or get into a car with a Bluetooth® connection to your iPhone.

      Note: To receive location-based reminders, you must allow Reminders to use your precise location. Go to Settings  > Privacy & Security > Location Services. Turn on Location Services, tap Reminders, choose While Using the App, then turn on Precise Location.

    • Get a reminder in Messages: Tap [Image: the Edit Details button], turn on When Messaging, then choose someone from your contacts list. The reminder appears the next time you chat with that person in Messages.

  3. Tap [Image: the Done button].

Set a flag and priority

  1. Go to the Reminders app on your iPhone.

  2. Tap an item.

  3. Do any of the following:

    • Flag an important item: Tap [Image: the Flag button].
    • Set a priority: Tap [Image: the Edit Details button], tap Priority, then choose Low, Medium, or High.

Add a photo or scan a document

  1. Go to the Reminders app on your iPhone.

  2. Tap an item, then tap [Image: the Photos button].

  3. Do any of the following:

    • Take a new photo.
    • Choose a photo from your photo library.
    • Scan a document.
    • Scan and insert text.

See alsoComplete items in Reminders on iPhoneUse Smart Lists in Reminders on iPhone

Add or remove accounts

In the Reminders app, you can use multiple accounts—such as iCloud, enterprise-managed iCloud, Microsoft Exchange, and Yahoo—and keep all your to-do lists in one place. Your reminders stay up to date on all your devices that use the same accounts.

Note: All Reminders features described in this guide are available when you use updated reminders in iCloud. Some features aren’t available when using other accounts.

Keep your reminders up to date on all your devices with iCloud

  1. Go to the Settings app  on your iPhone.
  2. Tap your name.
  3. Tap iCloud, tap See All, then turn on Reminders.

Your reminders stored in iCloud—and any changes you make to them—appear on your iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, and Mac where you’re signed in to the same Apple Account.

Update your reminders stored in iCloud

If you’ve been using Reminders with iOS 12 or earlier, you may need to update your reminders stored in iCloud to use features such as attachments, flags, list colors and icons, and more.

  1. Go to the Settings app  on your iPhone.

  2. Tap your name.

  3. Tap iCloud, tap See All, then make sure Reminders is turned on.

  4. Go to the Reminders app .

  5. On the Welcome to Reminders screen, choose one of the following options:

    • Update Now: Begin the update process.
    • Update Later: A blue Update button appears above your lists; tap it when you’re ready to update your reminders.

Note: Updated reminders aren’t backward compatible with the Reminders app in earlier versions of iOS and macOS. See the Apple Support article Update the Reminders app in iOS 13 or later.

Add other accounts

You can use the Reminders app to manage your to-do lists in other accounts, such as Microsoft Exchange and Yahoo.

  1. Go to the Settings app  on your iPhone.

  2. Tap Apps, then tap Reminders.

  3. Tap Reminders Accounts, then tap Add Account.

  4. Do one of the following:

    • Choose an account provider, then enter your account information.
    • If your account provider isn’t listed, tap Other, tap Add CalDAV Account, enter your account information, then turn on Reminders for that account.

Remove an account

When you remove or delete an account, the reminders in that account no longer appear on your iPhone. The reminders remain in your internet account (for example, iCloud.com or Microsoft Exchange) and any other devices you had already set up.

  1. Go to the Settings app  on your iPhone.

  2. Tap Apps, then tap Reminders.

  3. Tap Reminders Accounts, then tap the account you want to remove.

  4. Do one of the following:

    • Stop using Reminders on the account: Turn off Reminders.

      You can continue to use the account for other services, such as Calendar.

    • Stop using all services on the account: Tap Sign Out (for an iCloud account) or Delete Account (for other accounts).

      If you don’t see Sign Out or Delete Account, your account may be managed by your organization. See an administrator for removal instructions.

See alsoUse iCloud on iPhoneSet up mail, contacts, and calendar accounts on iPhone

Change Reminders settings

You can customize your preferences for the Reminders app in Settings. Choose the default list for new items, adjust notifications, and more.

Customize your Reminders settings

  1. Go to the Settings app  on your iPhone.

  2. Tap Apps, then tap Reminders.

  3. Adjust any of the following:

    • Accounts: Add or remove accounts in Reminders.
    • Location: Control the location information you share.
    • Siri: Allow Siri to make suggestions across apps based on the way you use Reminders.
    • Search: Allow suggestions and content from Reminders to appear in Search and widgets.
    • Notifications: Change notification settings.
    • Language: Choose your preferred languages (option appears when multiple languages are added).
    • Default List: Choose the list for new reminders you create outside of a specific list, such as reminders you create using Siri.
    • Today Notification: Set a time to see notifications for all-day reminders that have been assigned a date without a time.
    • Show as Overdue: The scheduled date turns red for overdue all-day reminders.
    • Time Zone: Set the time zone used to display and create reminders.
    • Include Due Today: The badge count includes overdue items and items due today.
    • Mute Notifications: Turn off notifications for assigned reminders.
    • Show Suggestions: If you type text that matches a previously completed reminder, that reminder appears as a suggestion.
    • Add Language: Set an additional language that Reminders uses to automatically place grocery items into categories.
    • Reset Categories: Clears the categorization that was learned as you manually moved items in grocery or auto-categorized lists. This applies to new items you add on any of your devices, including in lists you’ve shared. Existing items and lists shared with you won’t be affected.

Change the sound for reminder alerts

  1. Go to the Settings app  on your iPhone.
  2. Tap Sounds & Haptics, then tap Reminder Alerts.
  3. Choose a sound from the list.

You can also choose None if you don’t want to hear a sound when you receive a reminder alert.

See alsoFind settings on iPhone

Complete items

In a Reminders list, you can check off items to mark them as completed. With the Reminders widget, you can complete items from the iPhone Home Screen or Lock Screen.

Mark an item as completed

  1. Go to the Reminders app on your iPhone.

  2. While viewing a list, tap the empty circle next to an item to mark the item as completed.

    Completed items are hidden on your list.

To unhide completed items, tap [Image: the More button], then tap Show Completed. To delete the completed items, tap Clear.

Use the Reminders widget

With the Reminders widget, you can complete items from the Home Screen without opening the Reminders app .

  1. On the iPhone Home Screen, add the Reminders widget.
  2. To change the list shown in the widget, touch and hold the widget, tap Edit Widget, then choose a list.
  3. To complete an item, tap the item in the widget.

See alsoEdit and organize a list in Reminders on iPhoneUse Smart Lists in Reminders on iPhone

Create reminders

It’s easy to create reminders on your iPhone. You can add them in the Reminders and Calendar apps, or create one instantly without leaving the app you’re currently in.

Siri: Ask Siri something like, “Add artichokes to my groceries list.” Learn how to use Siri.

Note: All Reminders features described in this guide are available when you use updated reminders in iCloud. Some features aren’t available when using other accounts.

Create a reminder

  1. Go to the Reminders app on your iPhone.
  2. Tap [Image: the New Reminder button], then enter a description.

Create a reminder without switching apps

To create a reminder over any app or screen, do any of the following:

  • Add [Image: the Reminders button] to Control Center, then tap [Image: the Reminders button] in Control Center.
  • On supported models, assign Reminders to the Action button, then press and hold the Action button.

Create a reminder in Calendar

See Use Reminders in Calendar.

Get intelligent suggestions

If Apple Intelligence* is turned on, you can get suggested reminders from text in other apps—like tasks, grocery items, and follow-ups—based on emails or other text on your iPhone. See Use Apple Intelligence in Reminders on iPhone.

*Apple Intelligence is available in beta with support for the following languages: English, Danish, Dutch, French, German, Italian, Norwegian, Portuguese, Spanish, Swedish, Turkish, Chinese (Simplified), Chinese (Traditional), Japanese, Korean, and Vietnamese. Some features may not be available in all languages or regions. For more information on language and feature availability and system requirements, see the Apple Support article How to get Apple Intelligence.

See alsoMake a grocery list in Reminders on iPhoneAdd details in Reminders on iPhoneComplete items in Reminders on iPhone

Delete and recover reminders

You can permanently delete items from your Reminders lists. If you accidentally delete an item, you can recover it within 30 days from the Recently Deleted list.

Delete an item

  1. Go to the Reminders app on your iPhone.
  2. While viewing a list, swipe left on an item, then tap Delete.

To undo immediately, tap with three fingers or shake your iPhone.

Recover or permanently delete recently deleted items

  1. Go to the Reminders app on your iPhone.

  2. In the list view, tap Recently Deleted.

  3. Do one of the following:

    • Recover an item: Tap the item, then tap Recover. The item moves to the default list.
    • Permanently delete an item: Swipe left on the item, tap Delete, then tap Delete again. The item is removed immediately from all your devices.

Items left in Recently Deleted are automatically and permanently removed after 30 days.

Edit and organize a list

In the Reminders app, you can organize a list with sections and subtasks. You can also view the sections as columns and easily move items to different columns.

Note: All Reminders features described in this guide are available when you use updated reminders in iCloud. Some features aren’t available when using other accounts.

Edit a list

  1. Go to the Reminders app on your iPhone.

  2. While viewing a list, tap [Image: the More button], then do any of the following:

    • Change the list name, type, color, or icon: Tap Show List Info.

    • Edit multiple items: Tap Select Reminders or Select Items, then select the items you want to edit. You can also drag two fingers over the items. Use the buttons at the bottom of the screen to add a date and time, move, delete, assign, complete, tag, or flag the selected items.

    • Sort items by due date, creation date, priority, or title: (not available in all Smart Lists) Tap Sort By, then choose an option.

      When you sort or reorder a list, the new order is applied to the list on your other devices where you’re using updated reminders. If you sort or reorder a shared list, other participants also see the new order (if they use updated reminders).

    • Remove the list: Tap Delete List.

Manually reorder or recategorize items in a list

  1. Go to the Reminders app on your iPhone.
  2. While viewing a list, touch and hold an item you want to move, then drag it to a new location.

Organize with sections

  1. Go to the Reminders app on your iPhone.

  2. While viewing a list, do any of the following:

    • Create a new section: Tap [Image: the More button], tap New Section, then enter a name.

    • Collapse a section: Tap [Image: the Collapse button].

    • Expand a section: Tap [Image: the Expand button].

    • Rename section: Tap the section name, then enter a new name.

    • Move a section: Touch and hold the section, then drag it to a new position.

      Note: You can’t move the Others section.

    • Remove a section: Swipe left on the section, then tap Delete.

      Note: Removing a section will also delete the section’s reminders.

If Apple Intelligence* is turned on, you can automatically categorize related reminders into sections within a list. See Use Apple Intelligence in Reminders.

View the sections as columns

You can view the list in columns, making it easy to visualize and recategorize the items.

  1. Go to the Reminders app on your iPhone.
  2. While viewing a list, tap [Image: the More button], then tap View as Columns.
  3. To recategorize an item, drag it into a different column.

Create subtasks

  1. Go to the Reminders app on your iPhone.
  2. While viewing a list, swipe right on an item, then tap Indent. Or drag an item onto another item.

If you complete a main task, the subtasks are also completed. If you delete or move a main task, the subtasks are also deleted or moved.

*Apple Intelligence is available in beta with support for the following languages: English, Danish, Dutch, French, German, Italian, Norwegian, Portuguese, Spanish, Swedish, Turkish, Chinese (Simplified), Chinese (Traditional), Japanese, Korean, and Vietnamese. Some features may not be available in all languages or regions. For more information on language and feature availability and system requirements, see the Apple Support article How to get Apple Intelligence.

See alsoOrganize multiple lists in Reminders on iPhoneTag items in Reminders on iPhone

Get started with Reminders

The Reminders app helps you remember anything you need to track. You can set reminders, make grocery lists, create checklists for projects, and organize tasks in to-do lists.

Set a reminder

Simply type, dictate, or ask Siri when you need to remember something.

Create a grocery list

Make your shopping easier with a grocery list that automatically sorts items into categories. To convert a regular list into a grocery list, tap [Image: the More button], tap Show List Info, tap List Type, then choose Groceries.

Collaborate on a list

To invite people to work on a list, tap [Image: the Share button], then choose a sharing option.

Organize your reminders

You can create new lists to suit your needs, categorize with tags, and manage your reminders with Smart Lists.

Note: All Reminders features described in this guide are available when you use updated reminders in iCloud. Some features aren’t available when using other accounts.

Want to learn more?

  • Create reminders on iPhone
  • Make a grocery list in Reminders on iPhone
  • Share lists and collaborate in Reminders on iPhone
  • Use Smart Lists in Reminders on iPhone

Make a grocery list

In the Reminders app, you can create a grocery list to make shopping easier. Items are automatically sorted into categories such as Produce and Seafood. You can change how items are grouped, and the list remembers your preferences.

Note: All Reminders features described in this guide are available when you use updated reminders in iCloud. Some features aren’t available when using other accounts.

Create a new grocery list

  1. Go to the Reminders app on your iPhone.
  2. Tap [Image: the Add List button].
  3. Enter a name for the list, tap List Type, then choose Groceries.
  4. Choose a color and symbol for the list (optional).
  5. Tap [Image: the Done button].

Convert an existing list to a grocery list

  1. Go to the Reminders app on your iPhone.
  2. Tap a list, then tap [Image: the More button].
  3. Tap Show List Info.
  4. Tap List Type, then choose Groceries.
  5. Tap [Image: the Done button].

Add an item to your grocery list

  1. Go to the Reminders app on your iPhone.
  2. In your grocery list, tap [Image: the New Item button], then enter a description.
  3. To enter more information, tap Add Note.
  4. Tap [Image: the Edit Details button] to edit the item details. For example, you can attach a photo, set a location-based reminder, or flag an important item.
  5. Tap [Image: the Done button].

Items added to the list are automatically placed in categories. If you enter grocery items in a language different from the system language of your iPhone, you can add an additional language in Settings. (Grocery categorization is available for supported languages.)

See alsoComplete items in Reminders on iPhoneEdit and organize a list in Reminders on iPhoneShare lists and collaborate in Reminders on iPhone

Organize multiple lists

In the Reminders app, you can create new lists, organize the lists into groups, and pin lists for quick access.

Note: All Reminders features described in this guide are available when you use updated reminders in iCloud. Some features aren’t available when using other accounts.

Make a new list

  1. Go to the Reminders app on your iPhone.
  2. Tap [Image: the Add List button].
  3. Enter a name, then choose a color and symbol for the list.
  4. Tap List Type, then choose Standard, Groceries, or Smart Lists.
  5. Tap [Image: the Done button].

Pin an important list above the other lists for easy access

  1. Go to the Reminders app on your iPhone.

  2. Touch and hold a list, then tap Pin. You can also swipe right on the list, then tap [Image: the pin button].

    You can have a maximum of nine pinned lists.

To change the position of a pinned list, tap [Image: the More button], tap Edit Lists, drag [Image: the Reorder button] to a new position, then tap [Image: the Done button].

Create a group of lists

You can organize your lists in groups such as work, school, or shopping.

To create a group, simply drag a list onto another list. You can also do the following:

  1. Go to the Reminders app on your iPhone.
  2. Tap [Image: the More button], then tap Edit Lists.
  3. Tap Add Group, enter a name, select the lists to include in the group (optional), then tap [Image: the Done button].

Edit and rearrange lists and groups

  1. Go to the Reminders app on your iPhone.

  2. Tap [Image: the More button], tap Edit Lists, then do any of the following:

    • Rearrange lists and groups: Drag [Image: the Reorder button] a list or group to a new location. You can even move a list to a different group.
    • Change the name and appearance of a list or group: Tap [Image: the Edit Details button].

Delete a list or group

  1. Go to the Reminders app on your iPhone.

  2. Swipe left on the list or group, then tap [Image: the Delete button].

    When you delete a group, you have the option to keep the lists.

Deleted lists or groups are moved to Recently Deleted. You can recover them within 30 days of deletion. After 30 days, they’re permanently deleted.

See alsoTag items in Reminders on iPhoneUse Smart Lists in Reminders on iPhone

Print a list

You can print a grocery list, checklist, to-do items, project tasks, and more.

  1. Go to the Reminders app on your iPhone.
  2. View the list you want to print.
  3. Tap [Image: the More button], then tap Print.

See alsoPrint from iPhoneShare lists and collaborate in Reminders on iPhone

Search your lists

In the Reminders app, you can easily search through all your lists for items that contain specific text.

Search for items in all your lists

  1. Go to the Reminders app on your iPhone.
  2. Tap [Image: the Search button]
  3. In the search field, enter a word or phrase.

See alsoTag items in Reminders on iPhoneUse Smart Lists in Reminders on iPhone

Share and collaborate

In the Reminders app, you can use iCloud to share to-do lists. You can collaborate and assign tasks to other people who also use iCloud.

Note: All Reminders features described in this guide are available when you use updated reminders in iCloud. Some features aren’t available when using other accounts.

Collaborate on a list using iCloud

You can share a list and collaborate with people who use iCloud. People who accept the invitation can add and edit items, mark items as completed, and all the participants can see everyone’s changes. Everyone you collaborate with must be signed in to their Apple Account and have Reminders turned on in iCloud settings.

  1. Go to the Reminders app on your iPhone.
